QUOTE: "The index finds 4 spawn sites, all in `programs/`, none in `library/`" and "The library has no thread-spawning code of its own."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states that library/ creates no threads, but it never says library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers; it says only that the mutex code is compiled out by default and is initialised in `library/threading.c`.
